title: Build the first playable loop, recovery foundations and production art
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Adds a shared offline/Colyseus first loop for Soldier and Medic against Hollow Constable in Gatehouse: public/private rooms, reconnect, server-owned votes/shops/skills, eight supplies, queue/cold-start UX, build grades, masonry collision, later-phase/Brutal attacks, projectile pooling and limited north/south walks. Protocol 4. Other classes/routes/maps stay visibly In production.

Production art includes five four-direction survivor references and three individual boss studies, with all seventeen original/superseded natives preserved. Normalizes their 29 poses with common identity scales and measured foot anchors; integrates five native south-view portrait crops in setup while preserving class locks. Adds an eight-frame Lantern Warden attack study and a local art room with pose selection, playback/stepping, alpha grounds, anchors, scale comparison and provenance. Exact requests, both motion natives, extraction/pivot/timing receipts, pixel/hash audits and browser screenshots are preserved. Adds four idle and four raised-lantern channel frames, sixteen measured lantern attachment points and a separate local Phaser rehearsal. The shared 30 Hz signature reads the authored 55-degree cone, 24-degree/second rotation, 1.2-second tell and four-second active/rest windows; exact body-radius sector contact, locked aim, safe interior, animation timing and rehearsal damage cadence have nine additional checks. Range/damage/trailing-wedge width are explicit candidate tuning. Normal/public matches do not import the study. Full Warden attacks/phases/Accord/Brutal, hurt/defeat, networking and final Phaser motion acceptance remain pending. See WARDEN_SIGNATURE_REHEARSAL.md and the preserved ART_NORMALIZATION_AND_MOTION.md.

Adds signed boundaries, transactional SQL storage, authenticated bounded HTTP transport and a lease/claim journal with a server-only GraveRoom factory. Safe transitions wait for acknowledgements. Local tests cover separate-process HTTP/SQLite restart, owner races, response-loss retries and stale/finalized rejection. Normal/public execution has no journal writer configured; live D1, participant/new-transport recovery, historical roster and global rankings remain unfinished.

Validation: all 83 rule/WebSocket/HTTP/SQL/signature tests, strict TypeScript, content/fifteen-locale checks and production build pass. Production-art audits check 29 poses, five pixel-exact portraits, sixteen Warden motion frames and opaque lantern attachments, full native reconstruction, alpha clearance, 1.2-second anticipation and seventeen unchanged earlier natives. Assistant browser observations cover the local art room, 1280x900 desktop class layout and all five locked portrait bindings at 390x844 emulation; capture limits are documented. Control later returned disabled in Work settings during an incomplete offline-match smoke test. This continuation did not retry browser control. New native/contact-sheet/pixel audits and a separate rehearsal build are not rendered Phaser approval. No new foreground/device/human/native-language pass is claimed. Historical protocol-4 local 49+1 server p99 is 19.772 ms with exactly 4,000 hostiles; current foreground acceptance remains open.

The anonymous eight-slot Practice playtest remains at https://grave-accord-playtest.ivoryflame12.chatgpt.site/. Latest recorded deployments are frontend 33b36bc and gameplay dfade88; this source checkpoint does not redeploy them. The Site belongs to another ChatGPT account and requires legitimate owner/editor access. Fifteen canonical Wiki pages and prior publication evidence are preserved; new canonical changes require matching publication verification.

Keep draft. Full kits/bosses/routes/action art, live recovery/rankings, full capacity/endurance, physical phone/controller/human/native-language evidence, portable Windows/offline/LAN and final release gates remain open. Progress toward #4 and #5 without closing their acceptance criteria. Preserves the original work, MIT license and sealed Stage 1 artifacts.
